newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KLTC buys 3,137 tonnes of frozen pork.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KLTC buys 3,137 tonnes of frozen pork.

text.p: Korea Livestock Trading Corp (KLTC) saud on Wednesday it bought a total of 3,137 tonnes of frozen pork through a tender on Tuesday.
A KLTC official said it will invite tenders for 370.5 tonnes of frozen pork by 11 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Thursday.
The KLTC official said it bought 698 tonnes from Denmark, 552 tonnes from the United States, 580 tonnes from Belgium, 476 tonnes from Britain, and 831 tonnes from Canada.
The official said delivery was set for May 25 to Seoul and Pusan.
He said the amount of 3,137 tonnes included a replacement of about 2,700 tonnes of previously purchased Dutch pork after an outbreak of swine fever in the Netherlands in early February.
Since January, South Korea has bought a total of 19,629.5 tonnes of pork as part of the government plan to buy 20,000 tonnes of pork to ease domestic prices, he said.
The official said the purchase was in addition to the country's obligation to buy 14,620 tonnes this year under the Minimum Market Access (MMA) requirement of the World Trade Organisation.
South Korea has said it would open its pork market from July 1 this year.
